billing.charges_refunds.title: Unexpected charges and unresolved refunds
billing.charges_refunds.description: Customers report being charged more than expected, including duplicate charges, and say refunds are not provided when they should be.

access.login_failure.title: Cannot log in to the account
access.login_failure.description: Customers are unable to sign in, typically because the app rejects their password even when they believe it is correct.

playback.crash_or_wont_open.title: App crashes or will not open
playback.crash_or_wont_open.description: Customers say the app crashes repeatedly or fails to open at all, making it impossible to use.

downloads.downloads_disappear.title: Downloaded songs vanish after updates
downloads.downloads_disappear.description: Customers find that music they downloaded for offline listening disappears, often after an app update, and must be downloaded again.

usability.ads.title: Ads interrupt listening too often
usability.ads.description: Free-tier customers say ads play too frequently, such as after every song, which interrupts their listening experience.
